data.title: 克莱尔 · 危局废墟中的坚壁守护
data.description: 坍塌的古建筑残垣中尘土飞扬，克莱尔横剑挡在少年身前。校服多处破损，紫眸燃起决不妥协的凶猛杀意，誓死捍卫身后之人的安危。
data.location: crumbling ancient stone sanctuary hall with swirling dust and rubble
data.action: standing defensively in front of Cid with sword raised in two hands, torn uniform showing combat scrapes, burning protective fury in violet eyes
data.lighting: turbulent red dusk light through fractured ceiling illuminating determination
data.mood: fierce protective love, desperate sacrificial courage, unbreakable sibling bond
data.promptProse: In crumbling stone ruins, black ponytail Claire stands defensively with drawn sword, eyes blazing fiercely to protect someone behind her.
data.animaCaption: Claire standing as an unbreakable shield in the collapsing ruins.
